scope: Six Seaborn study figures drawn from the sealed combined evidence of release run 39810108196 (24 completed cells, 60 completed comparisons); every mark, whisker and connector was verified in code against the admitted rows before this visual review. Four figures are byte-identical to hosted render run 39837656304; the workload and strata figures were redrawn by the current figures.py in the container described under render.

render.kind: container reproduction of the hosted report job
render.figure_dpi_scope: Quarto's Jupyter kernel sets figure.dpi to 96 before the report's cells run; tight_layout measures text at that dpi, so the reproduction sets the same value.

reproduces.statement: With the figures.py of that commit, the same container and settings render all 19 study-data files of the run's report artifact (CSVs, 12 PNG/SVG and plot-validation.json) byte for byte from the sealed evidence.

checks: All 478 plotted marks (strict and collapsed) match the admitted quality, paired, performance and strata rows (plot-validation.json, checked in code at render time); workload whiskers and strata connectors are checked end point by end point.
Every panel has a zero-based or symmetric axis, readable row labels with scored/selected, failure and metric-limit counts, and an uncropped footnote.
The Rust and Python Indra marks coincide in every quality panel and the paired figure draws their self-comparison at zero without an interval.
The paired figure draws every interval as retained (fast PSM3 reference without an estimated interval); intervals crossing zero are not presented as superiority.

The strata figure keeps every level label inside its own gap (gap 3.328 in, widest label 3.328 in), places adjacent arms 6.981 pt apart against a 6.577 pt mark so equal values stay visible per arm in the nine-level domain panel (the earlier render hid three of six arms on modern_legal and historical_natural_science), and draws each arm's open collapsed mark joined to its filled strict mark.

The workload figure draws min-max whiskers of the three per-repetition throughput and p50 values (narrower than the mark for most arms) and names each budget's CPU model, AVX-512F flag, logical CPUs, SMT siblings and host in its footer.
No default promotion, representative-quality or production speed claim; the two CPU budgets ran on separate hosts and are not read as CPU scaling.

independent_review.status: pending for the regenerated workload and strata figures; the other four PNGs are the bytes it reviewed

previous.statement: Independent read-only visual review (second session) of the six PNGs at full resolution from run 39837656304: marks, counts, zero baselines, footnotes legible, no label collisions; strata layout defect of run 39836460897 resolved. The other five PNGs and quality.csv, performance.csv and summaries.csv are byte-identical to run 39836460897.
